artifact_type: cross-state structural module candidates from shared representative vocabulary IDs, NOT semantic equivalence or causality

axes.generation: same transformer state, adjacent generated-token decision

match_criterion: >=4 shared representative token IDs and shared_count/min(source_size,target_size) >= 0.08
limitations: Representative tokens are a lossy summary of each community, not all node membership
Different wording can express the same semantic parent even when representative token ID overlap is zero
Shared token IDs do not establish identity of the higher-order semantic relation
Unmatched links remain unresolved, not necessarily absent
